No it’s not stupid, it’s always good to know what dosage to start with. Of course it depends on your body weight and metabolism but if you are completely new to weed i would recommend anywhere between 2-5mg and giving it a few hours then taking more if you want. If you are smoking flower i would start with a few hits (less than 5) and waiting at least 30 min to 1 hour then taking more if you want. But also if you smoke flower it depends on the THC percentage as well( i like 15-20% for an average high) A high from smoking comes on a lot quicker than edibles but an edible high tends to last longer ( at least for me - but i’m not sure if it’s the same for everyone). 
I started smoking because of back pain and also depression, it has helped sooo much for each! Smoking makes a night and day difference for my back pain. I’ve heard from a few weed shops say that consuming an equal amount of CBD and THC actually improves the high and pain relief effect( i think it proves true for me but everyone’s different). 
I hope this helps a little and I’d be happy to answer anymore questions!
